title: 指令微调在语言模型中植入并强化数字选择启发式
summary: 研究通过精确计算而非采样，测量18个开源模型在随机数字任务中的概率分布，发现指令微调使分布更不均匀：植入回避整数的启发式，强化回避端点的启发式，但未形成跨模型共享的偏好数字。
summary_en: Measuring exact probability distributions over random-number choices in 18 open-weight model lines, the study finds instruction tuning makes distributions less uniform: it installs round-number avoidance, sharpens endpoint avoidance, but does not create a shared favorite integer across models.
